purpose: Upgrade the existing Primary Chat canary into a public-safe control surface prototype that mirrors complete Prometeo replies, renders temporal handoff/action widgets, and derives route-back guidance from durable worker/run evidence without pretending private web ingress exists.
allowed_scope: candidate compiler/test artifacts inside same RUN scope
no production chat-canary mutation in this experiment
required_outputs: candidate HTML using the existing Primary Chat visual language
message renderer for full body + structured details/widgets
worker/run terminal route-back example using durable META-AUTONOMY-01 evidence
compiler/projection proposal that avoids browser raw API fan-out
success: A human can understand the complete current response and exact next action from the public page alone; when no action is needed the page says so; when a run closes the page can tell the human exactly where/how to resume, without manual result copying.
